_comment: Inputs of the Claude plugin directory build (build.mjs). The directory accepts only plugin files, so this lists every file the lean tree contains and how each one is made from the root sources. The root files are never edited by the build. Each edit fails the build when its anchor is missing or repeated, and expectedHeadings and sectionMustContain pin what the edited copy must contain.

mustContain: listed on the plugin's **Connectors** tab in **Customize > Plugins**

edits.paragraph: Only if the server is absent from Claude Code's configuration, have the user add it for all their projects: `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user mnemoverse https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp`, then authenticate from `/mcp`. Without `--scope user` the server is added for the current project only.

edits.find: A host-native entry may intentionally replace the plugin entry, as on Hermes Agent.
In Claude Code, choose Authenticate or Re-authenticate as offered; in Hermes, use `hermes mcp login mnemoverse`.
edits.with: In Claude Code, choose Authenticate or Re-authenticate as offered.

edits.find: Follow the current host's [installation guide](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/install-by-host); for OpenClaw, use its [OpenClaw section](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/install-by-host#openclaw). Do not substitute Claude Code commands for another host's sign-in flow.
edits.with: In chat on claude.ai, in the Claude desktop and mobile apps, and in Cowork, the server this plugin declares is listed on the plugin's **Connectors** tab in **Customize > Plugins** (claude.ai or the desktop app); connect it there and complete the sign-in in the browser ([plugin support by surface](https://claude.com/docs/plugins/platform-support)). For other ways to connect those apps, see the [Claude apps guide](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/claude-apps). Do not substitute Claude Code commands for another host's sign-in flow.

expectedHeadings: ## If tools or sign-in are missing

### Claude apps and Cowork: listed on the plugin's **Connectors** tab in **Customize > Plugins**
